blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Time period, displacement, velocity aur acceleration ke jo formulas projection (saye) ke liye sahi hain, woh circle mein ghoomte particle par bhi apply hote hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh formula velocity ka magnitude (miqdar) deta hai. Direction (simt) bhi dekhein to jab x positive (musbat) ho aur Q, O ki taraf aa raha ho to velocity negative (manfi) hai: v = −x₀ω sinωt. Isi liye aage Fig. 14.9 (b) ka graph pehle neeche jata hai.
sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, is liye sinθ = √(1 − cos²θ). Ise (14.12) mein rakhein:

blocks.text_alt: v = x₀ω√(1 − x²/x₀²)   (kyun ke cosθ = x/x₀)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Eq. (14.13) ko v = ω√(x₀ − x²) = √((k/m)(x₀² − x₀²)) chhapa hai. Pehle hisse mein x₀ ka square reh gaya hai aur doosre mein x² ki jagah x₀² chhap gaya hai (is tarah to v hamesha 0 aata). Sahi v = ω√(x₀² − x²) = √((k/m)(x₀² − x²)) hai, jo upar likhi hai.
